title: Exterior Painting in Newberry, FL | Stucco & Siding
description: Exterior painting in Newberry, FL: wash, re-caulk, repair, and two coats of acrylic or elastomeric on stucco, siding, and trim. Up to 10-year warranty.
heroIntro: From fresh stucco subdivisions toward Town of Tioga to wood-sided homes near downtown, Newberry exteriors get a coating system chosen for the wall in front of us.

sections.h2: Signs your Newberry exterior is ready
body: Run a hand across a sunny wall. If it comes away chalky, the binder is breaking down. Other signals we see on Newberry homes:
bullets: Faded color on the west and south sides compared to the north
Open caulk joints around windows and trim on newer homes as framing settles
Green or black growth at the base of walls hit by sprinklers
Peeling or soft wood at fascia, sills, and door frames on older homes
Fine stucco cracks that have begun to open wider each season

sections.h2: Newberry Oaks stucco versus West End clapboard
body: If your home is one of the newer builds in Newberry Oaks, Arbor Greens, or Country Way, the walls are most likely stucco or fiber-cement with painted trim. Where those stucco walls are flexing at hairlines, we apply an elastomeric coating able to stretch across the gaps, and anything wider gets patched before coating. Fiber-cement boards and the trim around them are finished in 100% acrylic. Prep on a subdivision house like this is mainly a good wash, new caulk, and primer on the odd bare spot.

Out by Downtown Newberry and the West End, the restored wood-sided houses are a separate kind of project. Their clapboard and trim are scraped until the remaining paint is tight, sanded, repaired where rot has started, and primed wherever wood is exposed. The schedule allows more prep days, and the estimate shows them.

sections.h2: Coating a Newberry exterior, layer by layer
body: We begin each Newberry exterior by washing the house and killing any mildew. Repairs follow: popped nails reset, rotten boards and fascia swapped, cracked joints cut out and refilled with a flexible sealant that takes paint, and exposed spots primed. Finish arrives as a pair of full coats from premium Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore lines, or three coats when the color changes dramatically or the surface is porous. Whatever we spray gets back-rolled or back-brushed straight after, pushing paint into stucco texture and rough-sawn wood.

sections.h2: Best months for a Newberry exterior
body: For Newberry exteriors we steer toward October through May. Summer jobs begin at daybreak, with the crew checking dew point and watching radar for the afternoon storms that build west of Gainesville. Most houses need three to seven working days of painting, and the wash and dry time is added to that. Why the calendar matters so much is covered in our article on how weather affects house painting in Florida.

Your exterior is covered by a written workmanship warranty of up to 10 years, separate from the manufacturer's product coverage. For stucco damage beyond hairlines, see stucco repair and painting. Many Newberry clients add a driveway and walkway wash or deck staining while the crew is there. Everything else we offer in our hometown is on the Newberry location page.

faqs.q: Can you match my HOA's approved exterior colors?
faqs.a: Yes. Bring the approved chip from your Newberry community, or we can sample existing siding, and we will prepare full-size drawdowns to go with the paperwork you submit.

faqs.q: Do I need to be home during exterior painting?
faqs.a: No. As long as we have access to water, outlets, and the yard, you can go about your day.

faqs.q: What happens if you find rotten wood?
faqs.a: Any rot the crew lead finds on the walkthrough is already broken out on your estimate. If more turns up once old boards come off, we stop and show you, and that repair happens only after you approve it in writing.
